mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MAIL_ACCOUNT (user_id, imap_host, imap_port, imap_username, encrypted_password, use_ssl) VALUES (#{userId}, #{imapHost}, #{imapPort}, #{imapUsername}, #{encryptedPassword}, #{useSsl})
mapper.update: UPDATE MAIL_ACCOUNT SET imap_host = #{imapHost}, imap_port = #{imapPort}, imap_username = #{imapUsername}, encrypted_password = #{encryptedPassword}, use_ssl = #{useSsl}, last_updt_pnttm = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
